articles.title: Yankees stuck with Austin Wells despite his struggles. He made them look smart
articles.description: Wells was on a historically bad pace after the first three months of the season, but the Yankees' decision to stay with him has paid off.

articles.title: Photographer at Yankees-Angels game struck in head by foul ball, carted off field
articles.description: A photographer in the first-base line camera well was struck in the head by a ball fouled out by Ben Rice.

articles.title: The Yankees have a Trent Grisham problem. Is there a solution?
articles.description: Grisham is mired in a 2-for-37 slump and continues to struggle in center field for the Yankees.

articles.title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. shrugs off Red Sox announcer: 'I'm not going to remember who he is'
articles.description: Broadcaster Will Flemming's suggestion that Boston's pitcher should throw at batter Austin Wells drew condemnation from several Yankees.

articles.title: In need of fresh bullpen arms, Yankees claim John Schreiber off waivers from Royals
articles.description: Schreiber joins a Yankees bullpen that has been overworked recently. He had a 3.65 ERA for the Royals before the waiver claim.

articles.title: Citing backlash, broadcaster Will Flemming apologizes after calling for Red Sox-Yankees fight
articles.description: "These rivalry games get me fired up; I apologize for letting the emotion of the moment get the best of me," Will Flemming wrote on X.

articles.title: The Yankees didn't address two of their biggest needs at the deadline. They're still in good shape
articles.description: The Yankees made attempts to acquire impact relievers and catcher Adley Rutschman, but would only go so far to get them.

articles.title: On a great day to be Yankees GM, Brian Cashman has hope for another ring
articles.description: Cashman said he is just as hungry to win a ring today as he was in 1998. As the Yanks routed the Red Sox, he talked about the team's goals.

articles.title: Broadcaster says Red Sox pitcher should drill Yankees’ Austin Wells, fight Jazz Chisholm Jr.
articles.description: Red Sox play-by-play man Will Flemming took exception to Jazz Chisholm Jr. stealing two bases with Yankees up six runs in eighth.

articles.title: Yankees make emphatic statement with series win over Red Sox: Takeaways
articles.description: The Yankees bashed five homers in a 16-1 rout of Boston, securing a series win that showed they could rise to the occasion when it mattered.

articles.title: Red Sox furious after controversial no-catch call in Yankees rout
articles.description: With playoff implications looming large for Boston, the no-catch call was particularly frustrating for the Red Sox.

articles.title: Yankees' George Lombard Jr. likely to avoid IL after knee injury scare
articles.description: The Yankees consider Lombard's availability to be day to day, though he seemed unlikely to play in Sunday's series finale against Boston.

articles.title: Yankees hopeful George Lombard Jr. can avoid IL; Red Sox season series finale looms
articles.description: The Yankees looked lifeless in Game 1, then Lombard exited with a knee injury. But they rebounded to salvage a doubleheader split.

articles.title: Three reasons Yankees' tight win over Red Sox was so important: 'Everything matters'
articles.description: Friday night's 1-0 win over Boston was significant for the Yankees in a heated AL East race. The little things wound up being huge.

articles.title: E-6: Yankees' George Lombard Jr. makes unfathomable history with error streak
articles.description: The rookie shortstop, long lauded for his defense, became the first MLB player since 1992 to make an error in six straight games.

articles.title: Yankees' George Costanza bobblehead giveaway has 'Seinfeld' fans lined up in the rain
articles.description: The Yankees gave away only 18,000 bobbleheads to "drive collectibility."

articles.title: Yankees' Aaron Judge wants to skip rehab games before return: 'Why waste ABs?'
articles.description: "I feel like if I tell them I'm ready to go play," Judge said, "I think we're ready to go play. I'm not a pitcher. I'm a position player."

articles.title: The Yankees are playing dangerous bullpen game, even in a win over Astros
articles.description: "We need to find out about people and see if they can step up in situations," Aaron Boone said.

articles.title: Yankees' Fernando Cruz suffers partial UCL tear, Tommy John 'on the table'
articles.description: The Yankees didn't trade for a reliever at the Aug. 3 deadline, and all they have done is take hits.

articles.title: Yankees' bullpen has a major crack ahead of October. Can it be fixed?
articles.description: Brent Headrick and Fernando Cruz had outings that prompt — or sustain — concern about the relief staff in a loss to the Astros.
